How do I use it properly the very first time?
Using your new Vertical Spice rack for the first time is straightforward!
1. Mount the Base: Position the unit in your cabinet and secure it to your shelf using the provided self-tapping screws and a Phillips screwdriver. All necessary mounting hardware is included.
At Your Service
2. Attach the Flex-Bands: Place the flexible polyester-and-rubber bands across the sides of each drawer channel. These stretch to hold your spice jars firmly in place.
Here to help you shop
menu
3. Load Your Spices: Slide your standard spice jars into the channels. If you have half-size jars, you can stack them two per slot with a band securing them.
4. Pull to Access: Gently pull the clear front handle. The steel ball-bearing slides allow the drawer to extend fully so you can easily see and reach every jar from front to back.
